name: Thunder Bluff
_terrain: Turtle's additions to the 3.3.5 city (no ground changes): the Ancestors on Spirit Rise (The Way of Spiritwalking), a priest trainer, Revantusk Watcher, Gewana, Lansa Skyseer.
_exclude_creatures: Turtle systems on Hunter Rise: training dummies, the bounty board dummy, the Thorn Gorge battlemaster; rented wolves. The Ancestors of Wisdom, Virtue and Humility: they only serve The Way of Spiritwalking (see _exclude_quests). Revantusk Watcher: his only quest (A Tusken Affair, 80300) ends at Volz'draza in Turtle's Orgrimmar, not ported.
_exclude_gameobjects: Gardening Zone Check, Speedy's Jukebox, the Blood Ring / battleground banners on Hunter Rise, an event trap (Cairne), Apple Bob, TEMP Greater Moonlight.
_exclude_quests: Bounty board (Turtle system), Thorn Gorge (Turtle battleground), the tauren priest chain (3.3.5 has no tauren priests). The Way of Spiritwalking I-V (40344-40348): a shaman chain whose reward is Turtle's new Spiritwalking spell (47262) - no new spells. Sage Truthseeker's Horde Uldum chain (40108, 40111, 40112, 40114): it leads to the Uldum gate left out in Tanaris and runs through the Barrens and Swamp of Sorrows NPCs not ported.
